card.name: Decimal point in section cross-references
card.fires_on: The period inside a section cross-reference in parentheses, such as ( 2.1 ) or ( 2.2 ), after the section number 2 or 5. It appears in the highlights of drug labels, after dosing sentences.

modes.label: Dosing section reference
modes.description: The period after "2" in a cross-reference that closes a dosing or administration sentence.
modes.example: Swallow tablets whole with or without food. ( 2<<.>>2 ) 2.1 Patient Selection

modes.label: Other section reference
modes.description: The period after a different section number, such as 5, in a reference that follows a warning sentence.
